Selective interior strokes suggest weathered stone, timber, cloth and leather; do not trace every stone, board, leaf or grass stem. Desaturated slate, soot, umber, restrained ochre and moss olive; naturally warm readable skin. Pelageya about38, sturdy, broad face/hands, dark blond hair under faded BLUE HEADSCARF, linen shirt, brown skirt, gray wool coat, leather shoes.
